method: Isolated PhysicsScene2D; BeginPhysicsStep -> MoveRotation/MovePosition -> Simulate -> CompletePhysicsStep. Raw solver values sampled before cleanup.

results.name: 180 degree sweep / anti-push on
results.detail: Must see actual solver injection, remove it after Simulate, and bound the position correction across all iterations. Clean delta compares final velocity with the controller-owned velocity after contact-normal blocking; contact-before/after delta is separately recorded.

results.name: 180 degree sweep / anti-push off
results.detail: Disabled protection must retain at least 1 unit/s of upward or lateral speed from contact while input is zero. Downward free-fall alone cannot pass this reproduction check.

results.name: Sweep against wall corner
results.detail: Must see actual solver injection, remove it after Simulate, and bound the position correction across all iterations. Clean delta compares final velocity with the controller-owned velocity after contact-normal blocking; contact-before/after delta is separately recorded.

results.name: Standing on rotating pillar / zero input and gravity
results.detail: Gravity is disabled only on this fixture to isolate inherited angular/tangential velocity. Expected final speed is zero, although bounded positional separation is allowed.

results.name: 180 degree first impact on stationary player / normal gravity
results.detail: A stationary player, with normal gravity, receives an actual 180-degree/s sweep contact. Full before/after velocity-vector change=0.008556931, gravity allowance=0.1635, raw solver change=9.007064

results.name: Moving platform velocity is not inherited
results.detail: A 2.4 unit/s translating platform must not carry the player horizontally; gravity and contact-normal blocking remain active.

results.name: Left overlap correction sign and whole-step budget
results.detail: Initial distance=-0.27, final distance=-0.12, normal=(-1.00, 0.00), position correction=(0.15, 0.00), velocity unchanged=True. Distance query must immediately observe the Rigidbody2D.position update.

results.name: Right overlap correction sign and whole-step budget
results.detail: Initial distance=-0.27, final distance=-0.12, normal=(1.00, 0.00), position correction=(-0.15, 0.00), velocity unchanged=True. Distance query must immediately observe the Rigidbody2D.position update.

results.name: Opposed contacts enter bounded upward escape after ten steps
results.detail: Opposite walls continuously overlap, correction alternates direction. Detected=True, frame=10, next-step escape=(0.00, 0.15). Death/restart after another ten blocked steps requires the Play-mode scene check.

results.name: IgnoreCollision pairs are restored when protection is disabled
results.detail: Ignored pairs=2, actual pair flags=True, restored when toggled off=True

results.name: Free-fall integrates gravity once
results.detail: After 60 x 1/60 seconds, expected=(0.00, -9.81), actual=(0.00, -9.81), error=4.768372E-06

results.name: Static floor preserves diagonal motion up to first impact
results.detail: At diagonal landing, legitimate motion before impact must remain. Start=(0,.5), velocity=(2,-4), final=(0.02, 0.47). Do not project away the entire pre-impact descent.

results.name: Static wall preserves approach up to first impact
results.detail: At diagonal wall impact, preserve the approach to wall and legal upward sliding. Start=(.65,1), velocity=(6,2), final=(0.68, 1.02)

results.name: Static slope walking without hovering
results.detail: Walking at 2 units/s onto a 15-degree static slope must keep normal contact and make forward progress, without an artificial hover gap. Final signed gap=0.0001001004, position=(3.69, 1.56)

results.name: Jetpack expiration restores owned gravity and consumes oxygen once
results.detail: Dash started=True, reduced owned gravity=0.2, restored=2, engine gravity=0, post-dash gravity integration error=1.101022E-07, oxygen spent=10

results.name: Jetpack stops before a wall with anti-push enabled
results.detail: After dash into wall, x=1.4799, wall's near face=1.8, player half-width=.3, gap=9.987876E-05, dashing=False, gravity restored=1, cooldown=0.5
